title: Learn at your pace
intro: Short essentials. No hype, and no price chart.
scamClose: Real Bitcoin has no manager. You hold it yourself.

flags.manage: Someone offering to trade or manage it for you
flags.words: Anyone asking for your recovery words

guides.bitcoinBody: It is money you can hold yourself. There will only ever be 21 million. No bank, manager, or admin can print more, freeze it, or hold it for you.
guides.yearsBody: The price moves a lot from day to day. A habit is for money you can leave alone for years. You can lose money. This is education, not a forecast.
guides.custodyBody: The keys stay on your phone. The recovery words are the backup. Anyone who sees those words can take the bitcoin. PesaSense never asks for them.

scenarioTitle: What could happen to your savings?
startBody: Set up a steady habit based on your available surplus.
reimport: If that does not match your real life, re-import with {link} — PDF parsing is still hit-or-miss on some statements.
safeUpTo: You can safely save up to {amount}.
quizTitle: When is this Bitcoin pot for?
choiceYears: After 3 or more years, for a plan you already have
noteYears: That matches a patient habit. You still approve each purchase, and the value can fall.
noteRent: Money for next week belongs in the cushion. Bitcoin is for money you can leave alone.
noteDrop: Buying because the price fell is trading. This app does not do that.
education: This is education, not financial advice. Bitcoin can lose value.
disclaimer: Past performance does not indicate future results. This is education, not financial advice. Bitcoin can lose value.

ladder.label: Savings progression steps
ladder.bufferBody: Aim for {months} months of basic expenses safely set aside for peace of mind.
ladder.everydayBody: Keep funds for upcoming purchases or school fees in M-Shwari, Ziidi, or your standard savings account.
ladder.bitcoinBody: Bitcoin is one option for money you can leave alone for years. The value goes up and down, and you can lose money.

chart.title: A sketch, not a forecast
chart.body: Bitcoin's value goes up and down. Not a guarantee of future results. Based on a hypothetical {amount} held for 1 year.
chart.lowerBody: The value can fall. You can lose money.
chart.middleBody: It might stay near where it started.
chart.higherBody: It might be higher. This is not a forecast.
